1: This 6-week program is designed to help experienced climbers develop more finger strength. This program is suitable for climbers with a long training history with lots of experience using a fingerboard. This schedule should be carefully planned around your climbing week to maximise recovery between sessions.
8 sets of heavy finger curls with minimal rest
Max finger strength testing using a 10mm edge
10 sets of heavy flexor curls with minimal rest
Shoulder shrugs and one arm isometric holds using a pull up bar or jug hold
Shoulder shrugs whilst dead hanging on a finger board
Half crimp finger strength testing session
